description: This file defines the MatchMode enumeration used for pattern matching strategies in database queries, along with methods to generate case-sensitive or case-insensitive search patterns.

classes.name: MatchMode
classes.description: Enumeration representing different string matching modes: START, END, ANYWHERE, EXACT, providing methods to generate search patterns.

methods.name: toCaseSensitivePattern
methods.description: Generates a case-sensitive search pattern based on the MatchMode.

methods.name: toLowerCasePattern
methods.description: Generates a case-insensitive search pattern by converting the input string to lowercase.

methods.name: toPatternInternal
methods.description: Internal method that constructs the search pattern based on the MatchMode and case sensitivity.
